1: // Orbit Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
8:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.type = 'sine';
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     osc.start();
16:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
17:   }
18:   function playCollision() { playTone(150, 0.3); }
19:   function playThrust() { playTone(300, 0.1); }
20:   // Background hum (low volume)
21:   const humOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:   const humGain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:   humOsc.type = 'triangle';
24:   humOsc.frequency.value = 60;
25:   humGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:   humOsc.connect(humGain);
27:   humGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:   humOsc.start();
29:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
30:   if (!canvas) return;
31:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
32:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
33:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth * dpr;
34:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight * dpr;
35:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
36: 
37:   const planet = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 30 }; // central planet
38:   let ship = { angle: 0, radius: 100, size: 10 }; // ship size is radius of triangle base
39:   // generate starfield based on CSS size
40:   function initStars() {
41:     stars.length = 0;
42:     const cssWidth = canvas.clientWidth;
43:     const cssHeight = canvas.clientHeight;
44:     for (let i = 0; i < maxStars; i++) {
45:       stars.push({ x: Math.random() * cssWidth, y: Math.random() * cssHeight });
46:     }
47:   }
48:   initStars();
49:   const asteroids = [];
50:   const stars = []; // background stars
51:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
52:   const maxStars = 200; // starfield density
53:   const asteroidSpeed = 0.06; // radial speed per frame
54:   let lastSpawn = 0;
55:   let startTime = performance.now();
56:   let score = 0;
57: 
58:   function spawnAsteroid() {
59:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
60:     const distance = Math.max(width, height) / 2 + 20;
61:     asteroids.push({ angle, distance, size: 12 + Math.random() * 8 });
62:   }
63: 
64:   function update(dt) {
65:     // Ship control: up/down arrows adjust orbit radius
66:     // We'll listen to keydown events globally
67:     // (handled below)
68:     // Move ship along its orbit
69:     ship.angle += 0.0015 * dt; // constant angular speed
70:     // Update asteroids (move inward)
71:     for (let a of asteroids) {
72:       a.distance -= asteroidSpeed * dt;
73:     }
74:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       if (asteroids[i].distance < planet.r) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
77:     }
78:     // Spawn new asteroids
79:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
80:       spawnAsteroid();
81:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
82:     }
83:     // Collision detection
84:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
85:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
86:     for (let a of asteroids) {
87:       const ax = planet.x + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.distance;
88:       const ay = planet.y + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.distance;
89:       const dx = shipX - ax;
90:       const dy = shipY - ay;
91:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
92:       if (dist < ship.size + a.size) {
93:         // Game over
94:         playCollision();
95:         alert('Game Over! Time survived: ' + Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000) + 's');
96:         // Reset
97:         asteroids.length = 0;
98:         startTime = performance.now();
99:         ship.radius = 100;
100:         break;
101:       }
102:     }
103:     // Score
104:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
105:   }
106: 
107:   function draw() {
108:     // Draw starfield background
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
110:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
112:     for (let s of stars) {
113:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
114:     }
115:     // Planet with radial gradient
116:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.2, planet.x, planet.y, planet.r);
117:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
118:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
119:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
120:     ctx.beginPath();
121:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
122:     ctx.fill();
123:     // Ship as triangle pointing forward
124:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
125:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
126:     const heading = ship.angle + Math.PI / 2; // point outward
127:     const size = ship.size;
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
129:     ctx.beginPath();
130:     ctx.moveTo(shipX + Math.cos(heading) * size, shipY + Math.sin(heading) * size);
131:     ctx.lineTo(shipX + Math.cos(heading + Math.PI * 2 / 3) * size * 0.6, shipY + Math.sin(heading + Math.PI * 2 / 3) * size * 0.6);
132:     ctx.lineTo(shipX + Math.cos(heading - Math.PI * 2 / 3) * size * 0.6, shipY + Math.sin(heading - Math.PI * 2 / 3) * size * 0.6);
133:     ctx.closePath();
134:     ctx.fill();
135:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
136:     for (let a of asteroids) {
137:       const ax = planet.x + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.distance;
138:       const ay = planet.y + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.distance;
139:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(ax, ay, a.size * 0.2, ax, ay, a.size);
140:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f66');
141:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#900');
142:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
143:       ctx.beginPath();
144:       ctx.arc(ax, ay, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     }
147:     // Score text
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.fillText('Time: ' + score + 's', 10, 20);
151:   }
152: 
153:   let lastTime = performance.now();
154:   function loop() {
155:     const now = performance.now();
156:     const dt = now - lastTime;
157:     lastTime = now;
158:     update(dt);
159:     draw();
160:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
161:   }
162: 
163:   // Input handling with sound
164:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
165:     // Resume audio context on first interaction
166:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
167:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
168:       ship.radius = Math.max(planet.r + 20, ship.radius - 5);
169:       playThrust();
170:     }
171:     if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
172:       ship.radius = Math.min(Math.min(width, height) / 2 - 20, ship.radius + 5);
173:       playThrust();
174:     }
175:   });
176: 
177:   // Start loop
178:   loop();
179: })();
